text:
I'm sorry your fig arrived like this, and that you've felt ignored. A snapped main stem counts as damage on arrival, but those reports have to be made within 48 hours of delivery, so at 3 days you're past that window. A refund is only available through the DOA route, so I can't promise one.

You can still file a Plant Care Guarantee claim, since the 30-day guarantee (90 days for Leafy Plus members) is still open. Go to "My Orders" and upload at least two photos, one of the whole plant and one close-up. A Plant Care Specialist will review it within 2 business days. If approved, the remedy is one free replacement (or store credit if it's out of stock), not a refund, and you don't need to send the plant back.

If you'd like to ask for a refund anyway, I can escalate your case to a Support Lead. The policy I have doesn't say whether they can make an exception, so I can't promise the outcome. Would you like me to do that?
